description: Source code for diffcore break logic in a version control system, handling file pair comparisons, break decisions, and merging broken pairs.

methods.name: should_break
methods.description: Determines whether a pair of files should be considered broken based on edit size, type, and content differences.

methods.name: diffcore_break
methods.description: Splits file pairs into delete and create pairs if they are considered too different, based on break score.

methods.name: merge_broken
methods.description: Merges two broken file pairs back into a single pair if they are compatible.

methods.name: diffcore_merge_broken
methods.description: Iterates over queued diffs to merge back broken pairs where possible.
